description: Massachusetts motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Massachusetts?
questions.explanation: Massachusetts helmet law: all riders and passengers.

questions.q: What does Massachusetts law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Massachusetts: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: What does Massachusetts require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Massachusetts: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
